entries.german:
Raimundus de Lichtenburg, camerarius Bohemice, nomine regis Henrici Znoymensibus pro- mittit. quod subsidium ipsi civitati missum absque omni violentim molestia ibi permanebit. Datum Znoymce XIII. Kal. Novembris 1307.

XI. JV)s Raimundus de Lichtenburch Regni Boemie Camerarius, Tenore presentium notum facimus vniuersis, quod sincera fide et absque omni doli capcione, omnia promissa per honorabiles viros Jenkonem Marsalcum domini Witkonis de Lantstein et Nicolaum vice- purcrauiiun ipsius in Znoim, viris prudentibus, Gotzlino Judici, Juratis ac vniuersis Ciuibus et ipsi Ciuitati in Znoim facta una cum ipsis Jenkone et Nicolao predictis promittimus adimplere, videlicet quod ipsis Ciuibus ac Ciuitati sepedictis in omni neccessitatis articulo rebus et personis pro viribus assistemus, et ipsis tot homines quot pro necessitate Ciuitatis a nobis requisiuerint, sine ipsius Ciuitatis dispendiis et dampnis quibuslibet, et quandocumque voluerint in subsidium transmittemus, in ipsa ciuitate quam diu fuerint necessarij absque omni violencie molestia permansuros. Addicimus eciam promittentes quod ipsis Ciuibus ac Ciuitati memoratis nullus vmquam preter ciues ipsos, Rector Ciuitatis aliquis imponetur, sed ipsorum Ciuium fidelitati et industrie, ipsius Ciuitatis regimen sicut consuetum est hactenus, in posterum committetur. Obligamus nos insuper, quod omnes concessiones, iura atque dona 2 10 ciones, qu&s quondam Rudolfus Inclitus Boemie et Polonie Rex, prefatis Ciuibus ac Ciuitatl facere et concedere promisit in casibus infrascriptis, videlicet quod ipsa ciuitas ab omnibus exaccionibus omnino libera esse debeat per Sex annos; et quod Census quinque Marca- rum de villa dicta Schalichdorf, et census Sedecim Marcarum de Judicio Ciuitatis et villa wunnow, reformacioni Ciuitatis libere et perpetuo debeant deseruire, et quod predicta Ciuitas a modo Pragensibus Juribus et non aliis vti debeat, sicut in literis sepedicti Domini quondam Rudolfi Regis patencius est expressum, vna cum promissis viri Nobilis domini Heinrici de Rosenberch nostro, ac Witkonis de Lantstein nomine et loco Illustris domini nostri Heinrici Boemie et Pollonie Regis sepedictis Ciuibus ac Ciuitati factis, rate teneantur et firme, et quando obtinebimus ipsis easdem literis et Sigillis regalibus roborari et eciam renouari. Quod si non faceremus, ex tunc ipsi Goczlinus Judex, Jurati ac vniuersitas Ciui tatis ab omni fide et iuramento, domino nostro Heinrico Regi ac heredibus Regni predictis, factis, debent esse penitus absoluti; In cuius rei testimonium presentes fieri iussimus, Sigilli nostri et Sigillorum Jenkonis et Nicolai predictorum munimine roborari. Datum Znoyme Anno domini Millesimo Trecentesimo Septimo, XH1°. Kal. Nouembris. (Orig. membran. cum tribus bene conservatis sigiltis in archivo ejusdem civitatis).
entries.english:
Raimundus de Lichtenburg, chamberlain of Bohemia, on behalf of King Heinrich, promises the people of Znojmo that the aid sent to the city will remain there without any molestation by violence. Issued at Znojmo on 20 October 1307.

XI. We, Raimundus de Lichtenburg, chamberlain of the Kingdom of Bohemia, make known to all by these presents that, in good faith and without any deception, we promise to fulfil all the promises made by the honorable men Jenko, marshal of Lord Witko von Lantstein, and Nicolaus, his vice-burgrave at Znojmo, to the prudent Gotzlin, judge, the sworn officials, all the citizens, and the city itself of Znojmo, together with the aforesaid Jenko and Nicolaus. Namely, in every time of need we shall support those citizens and the aforesaid city with our resources and persons to the best of our ability, and whenever they wish we shall send them as many men as they request for the city’s needs, without any expense or damage to the city; those men shall remain in the city as long as they are needed, without any molestation by violence. We further promise that no one other than the citizens themselves shall ever be imposed upon them as rector of the city; rather, the city’s governance shall henceforth, as has been customary until now, be entrusted to the loyalty and competence of those citizens. Moreover, we bind ourselves that all grants, rights, and donations which the late illustrious Rudolf, King of Bohemia and Poland, promised to make and grant to the aforesaid citizens and city in the cases set out below—namely, that the city should be entirely free from all exactions for six years; that the rent of five marks from the village called Schalichdorf and the rent of sixteen marks from the city court and the village of Wunnow should be devoted freely and in perpetuity to the city’s restoration; and that henceforth the aforesaid city should use Prague law and no other, as is more fully set out in the letters of the aforesaid late King Rudolf—together with the promises made to the aforesaid citizens and city by the noble Lord Heinrich von Rosenberg in our name and in the name and place of our lord King Heinrich of Bohemia and Poland, and by Witko von Lantstein, shall remain valid and firm. When we obtain them, we shall have those same letters confirmed with royal seals and renewed. If we fail to do so, then Gotzlin, the judge, the sworn officials, and the whole community of the city shall be entirely released from every fealty and oath made to our lord King Heinrich and the heirs of the aforesaid kingdom. In witness of this, we have ordered this present letter to be made and strengthened by our seal and the seals of the aforesaid Jenko and Nicolaus. Given at Znojmo in the year of the Lord 1307, on the thirteenth day before the Kalends of November.
